messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 34):
"""
Give details of the following 4.10 Give the actuarial formulae, if any, used; if not, state how premiums are arrived at briefly explaining the methodology and details: 4.11 Source of data (internal/industry/ reinsurance) S No Item Particulars (to be filled by the Insurer) 4.12 Rate of morbidity [The tables wherever relevant shall be the prescribed one.] 4.13 Rates of policy terminations. [The rates used must be in accordance with insurer’s experience. If such experience is not available, this can be from the industry/reinsurer’s experience .] 4.14 Rate of interest, if any. [The rate or rates must be consistent with the investment policy of the insurer.] 4.15 Commission scales [Give rates of commission. These are explicit items.] 4.16 Expenses - Split into First Year, Renewal and Claim related:- [Expense assumptions must be company specific.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
